item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Claptone - Albums & Singles (Qobuz FLAC)
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're all doing well.

I was wondering if anyone happens to have any of the following Claptone albums or singles from Qobuz, preferably in their original FLAC quality.

Albums:

Charmer
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/charmer-claptone/5414939926440

Fantast
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/fantast-claptone/b3zi36vrq1wwb

Closer
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/closer-claptone/pijrndskb3qkc

Wanderer
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/wanderer-claptone/pnqs4zaul5z99

Singles:

Heartbeat
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/heartbeat-claptone/5414939939679

No Eyes
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/no-eyes-claptone/d2k4t2hh5ppaa

Drop the Pressure - Claptone & Mylo
https://www.qobuz.com/es-es/album/drop-the-pressure-claptone-mylo/iroopspkr70vb

If anyone happens to have any of these releases, even just one album or single, and would be willing to share it, I would really appreciate it. There's absolutely no need for one person to have the entire collection — any of these releases would be a great help.

Thank you very much in advance for your time and generosity. I truly appreciate any help!
